verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official CLI (inso) for automating test/collection execution via Git workflows, and documents scripting/chaining and Git Sync as programmatic-friendly features, showing some UI-to-automation parity. However, there's no evidence of a comprehensive public API or CLI covering the full UI surface (e.g., spec design, mock server creation, RBAC/org management, environments management) that would let an AI-native user fully replicate all UI actions programmatically. Missing for 10: evidence of API/CLI parity for design/mock-server/org/RBAC features, and any first-party API reference beyond the test-focused inso CLI.
